Diagnostic.description:
One finding about a record.

``field`` is a path within the record (``deductions[2].category``); null means the finding
is about the whole record. ``evidence`` cites a decision id or spec pointer; null means
none applies. These nulls are part of the type's meaning, so Diagnostic is a value type
and is not subject to the field_status rule.

RelatedPerson.description:

name. ``source_id`` is the provider's id for the person (PrismHR dependentId, isolved
contactId), used to join benefit dependents and beneficiaries (step 4). Identifying fields
are sensitive (street lines, postal code, phone numbers and the id value on the nested parts).

SourceRef.description:
Where a record's data came from.

``endpoint`` is the method and route template as documented by the provider, e.g.
``GET /api/clients/{clientId}/legals/{legalId}/employees/{employeeId}``. ``locator`` is a
JSON Pointer to the record inside that response body ("" means the whole body). Together
with the run's input (the source file, or a retained response) it locates the raw value;
on its own it does not hold the value.
